decision_points.name: Exploitation
decision_points.description: Current state of exploitation of the vulnerability.

decision_points.name: System Exposure
decision_points.description: Degree to which the vulnerable system is exposed.

options.label: Open
options.description: System is broadly exposed or reachable.

decision_points.name: Automatable
decision_points.description: Whether exploitation can be automated at scale.

options.label: No
options.description: Attack requires manual effort or chaining.

decision_points.name: Technical Impact
decision_points.description: Impact on the technical system if exploited.

options.label: Partial
options.description: Limited impact on system functionality or data.

options.label: Catastrophic
options.description: Loss of life or irreversible harm possible.

decision_points.name: Supplier Involvement
decision_points.description: Level of supplier engagement required to remediate.

options.label: Uncooperative/Unresponsive
options.description: Supplier is unresponsive or blocking remediation.

options.label: Out-of-Cycle
options.description: Fix outside the normal release cycle.
